articles.title: Three words from Kevin Warsh have Wall Street wondering how far the Fed will go with rate hikes
articles.summary: Warsh described Wednesday's decision to lift the central bank's benchmark rate by a quarter percentage point not specifically as a tightening of policy but rather as removing "a dose of accommodation."
